terms.meaning: A service record that links one request to its messages, issues and actions.
One distinct question or claimed right within a case.
The airline that performs or intends to perform the flight.
A statutory fixed payment for a qualifying disruption under EU261.
A return of the ticket price under the applicable refund right.
A payment for a necessary reasonable expense under an applicable duty.
A voluntary benefit separate from a legal right.
Alternative carriage to the final destination under comparable transport conditions.
Meals, communication, necessary accommodation and related transport under Article 9.
A legal defence that requires event, control, causation and reasonable-measures checks.
The relevant destination under Article 2(h) for the covered booking.
The smallest stored currency unit. One EUR has 100 minor units.
Special Drawing Right. This is a unit of account, not a fixed EUR amount.
A report for baggage tracing or an incident. Check whether it also satisfies the legal complaint requirement.
A transfer of responsibility to a person with the required skill or authority.
All issues have a result and accepted effects have confirmation. New material evidence can reopen the case.
An administrative record state. This state does not remove a legal right.
A demo action that sends no real message and moves no real money.
Retrieval-augmented generation. The system retrieves records before it prepares an answer.
An article, section or paragraph that identifies the supporting source text.
